identity.name: EEP Evoque Events Platform
identity.target_audience: Event planners, catering businesses, wedding planners in LATAM

headings.usage: Main page titles, hero sections, document headers (Quotes, BEOs)

body.usage: Dashboard data, form inputs, general text

mono.usage: Order numbers, SKU codes, financial data alignment

primary.description: Deep Sage Green - evokes nature, freshness, and stability

background.description: Bone White - softer than pure white, reduces eye strain

surface.description: Pure White - for cards and content areas to pop

spacing.philosophy: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 where p-4 is standard.

dashboard.rules: Use col-span-2 for main charts, col-span-1 for metrics. Fill height.

client_portal.rules: Asymmetrical layouts. Large hero images mixed with small text blocks.

surfaces.cards: bg-white border border-black/5 shadow-sm rounded-xl hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300
surfaces.documents: bg-white shadow-md max-w-[210mm] mx-auto min-h-[297mm] p-12 border-t-4 border-primary

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-primary/90 transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-secondary/80

inputs.style: bg-white border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-md h-11

navigation.sidebar: bg-primary text-white w-64 hidden md:flex flex-col fixed h-full z-50

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the #F9F9F7 background to add tactility.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-black/5 for definition without harsh lines.

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeOut' }}

hero_wedding.usage: Landing page hero, Client Portal welcome

workspace.usage: CRM Dashboard empty state, Settings page

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Use dark grey (#1A1A1A) on bone white.
accessibility.multilingual: Design containers to handle 20-30% text expansion for Spanish translations. Avoid fixed widths for text containers.

tech_stack_specifics.charts: Recharts with custom colors (Primary, Secondary, Muted Gold)

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Organic Luxury' color theme immediately in tailwind.config.js.
Use 'Playfair Display' for all H1-H3 headings and 'Manrope' for body.
Create a 'Layout' component that handles the Sidebar (Admin) vs Topbar (Client) logic.
Ensure the 'Documents' module (BEO, Quotes) uses a print-friendly CSS structure (@media print).
Use the provided image URLs for placeholders; do not use generic placeholders.
For the Multilingual toggle, ensure it persists state and swaps text instantly.
universal_guidelines: Avoid gradients for backgrounds; use solid colors or subtle textures.
Do not center-align text blocks longer than 3 lines.
Use 'gap-6' or 'gap-8' for grid layouts to maintain 'airiness'.
Interactive elements must have a hover state that changes color or lifts.
